translate_en|mods/TrueLineOfSight/common: Automatically checks visible zombies for building or vehicle obstruction without requiring the aim control. While enabled, both highlight-cone settings are ignored and Project Zomboid's current character visibility is used instead. This mode costs more performance than normal aiming mode. Default: enabled.
Highlights genuinely visible zombies obscured by patio, porch, petrol-station canopy and awning roofs. Disable this without affecting building, vehicle or staircase highlighting. Default: enabled.

Sets the minimum amount of light required on a zombie for it to be highlighted. Measured as a percentage. Higher values require brighter light; set to zero to disable darkness fading. Default: 10 percent.

Uses Project Zomboid's current player field of view for aimed highlights instead of the fixed Highlight Fade (Vision Cone) value. This follows changes to the character's actual vision. Automatic field-of-view scanning already uses this behaviour. Default: disabled.

Sets the fixed total width of the highlight cone, measured in degrees and centred on the character's facing direction. Zombies outside it fade immediately, including during the linger period. This does not alter the player's actual vision cone. This setting is ignored when dynamic vision cone or automatic scanning is enabled. Set to 360 degrees to disable cone fading. Default: 45 degrees.

Sets how long highlights remain after releasing the aim control or aiming away from a building or vehicle. Measured in seconds. Zombies that move clear of a targeted vehicle lose its highlight immediately. Proximity and vision-cone fading can also remove applicable highlights immediately. Default: 3 seconds.

Immediately removes a building-based zombie highlight when it reaches this distance from the player. This does not apply to vehicle-obstruction highlights. Measured in tiles. Set to 0 tiles to disable proximity fading. Default: 4 tiles.
Immediately removes and suppresses highlights for a building while Project Zomboid's normal proximity cutaway is active. Default: enabled.

Highlights genuinely visible zombies hidden at the top or bottom of a nearby staircase. When Project Zomboid omits the upper-floor character layer, a proportionally scaled placeholder marks the zombie's position. Default: enabled.
Highlights genuinely visible zombies whose sprites are obscured by a rendered vehicle. Disable this without affecting building-based highlighting. Default: enabled.
